questions.question: Which of the following is a tool that Microsoft Azure provides for creating machine learning models without writing code?
questions.explanation: Azure Machine Learning designer provides a drag-and-drop interface for creating machine learning models without writing code.

questions.question: Which Azure Cognitive Services service would you use to detect anomalies in time series data?
questions.explanation: Anomaly Detector is a Cognitive Service that helps you spot anomalies in time series data with machine learning.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of the Azure Bot Service?
options: To provide natural language processing capabilities
questions.explanation: Azure Bot Service enables you to build, test, deploy, and manage intelligent bots for conversational AI solutions.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a feature of Azure Cognitive Search?
questions.explanation: Azure Cognitive Search does not natively include image analysis and vision capabilities. For image analysis, you would use Computer Vision or Custom Vision services.

questions.question: Which responsible AI principle focuses on ensuring that AI systems operate reliably and safely?
questions.explanation: The Reliability and Safety principle focuses on ensuring that AI systems operate reliably and safely, minimizing unintended consequences and harmful outcomes.
